signals.text: 1 new PM role posted this week

bullets: Own product strategy, roadmap, and execution for a core Workstream product area, with a focus on hiring and recruiting experiences.
Define product vision, north star metrics, and success criteria aligned with company priorities.
Spend significant time with customers, candidates, recruiters, hiring managers, and customer-facing teams to identify patterns, pain points, and emerging market opportunities.
Leverage your experience in recruiting and hiring workflows to identify opportunities to make hiring more efficient, effective, and scalable for hourly businesses.
Partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Business Development, and Operations to gather business requirements and translate them into scalable product solutions.
